# Vendored test fixtures

- `sarif-schema-2.1.0.json`: the official SARIF 2.1.0 JSON schema (OASIS Static Analysis Results Interchange Format TC), used offline by `test/ci-formats.test.ts` to validate `scan --format sarif` output.
  - Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oasis-tcs/sarif-spec/main/sarif-2.1/schema/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json (schema id `https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/errata01/os/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json`), retrieved 2026-10-08.
  - SHA-256: c3b4bb2d6093897483348925aaa73af03b3e3f4bd4ca38cef26dcb4212a2682e
  - Copyright OASIS Open. Distributed under the OASIS IPR Policy; see https://www.oasis-open.org/policies-guidelines/ipr/. It is a test fixture only and is not shipped in the package.
- `ccan-rune-test-vectors.csv`: the rune test vectors of the ccan `rune` module that Core Lightning bundles (generated by the Python `runes` library; all-zero 16-byte master secret, so they carry no authority), used by `test/rune-decode.test.ts` and `test/rune-semantics.test.ts` to check macwarden's rune parser and condition semantics against upstream.
  - Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ElementsProject/lightning/v26.06.8/ccan/ccan/rune/test/test_vectors.csv (Core Lightning v26.06.8), retrieved 2026-10-09.
  - SHA-256: 11bd8868b004c9c8e56d2ddba045bff15992abcfa2766c65bf33bcb011a4e0ef
  - ccan/rune by Rusty Russell, licensed BSD-MIT (see ccan/ccan/rune/_info and ccan/licenses/BSD-MIT in the Core Lightning repository). It is a test fixture only and is not shipped in the package.
